input: Get an air quality monitor for the nursery

gold.taskTitle: Get an air quality monitor for the nursery
gold.taskDescription: Source and set up an air quality monitor specifically for a nursery room.

questions.title: What pollutants matter most to you right now?
questions.description: Understand which air quality factors the user wants to monitor, such as CO2, VOCs, particulates, humidity, or temperature.

questions.title: How old is the child using the nursery?
questions.description: Determine the age of the child to understand urgency and any specific safety or sensitivity considerations.

questions.title: Do you want real-time alerts sent to your phone?
questions.description: Clarify whether smart connectivity and app-based notifications are a required feature.

questions.title: What is your budget for this purchase?
questions.description: Establish a spending range to filter suitable product options appropriately.

questions.title: Is there a specific brand you already trust?
questions.description: Find out if the user has brand preferences or past experience with air quality devices.

questions.title: Do you prefer buying online or from a local store?
questions.description: Determine the preferred purchase channel to tailor sourcing recommendations.

questions.title: How soon do you need the monitor in place?
questions.description: Understand the timeline or urgency so the plan can account for shipping time or immediate availability.
